H: pasahati：[pa-sah] 征服，壓迫，強迫強制．ger．pasayha 無理不講理，強迫強制．pasayha-kārin 強迫強制者．ppr．sg．nom．pasahaṃ．
S: pasahati：[pa-sah] 征服す，壓迫す，強いる．ger．pasayha 無理に，強いて．pasayha-kārin 強制者．ppr．sg．nom．pasahaṃ．
D: Pasahati，（pa + sah + a），使用武力，使服从，压迫。 【过】 pasahi。 【独】~hitvā，pasayha。（p219）
F: Pasahati，（pa+sah胜过+a），使用武力，使服从，压迫。【过】pasahi。【独】pasahitvā，pasayha。
C: pasahati：[pa + sah + a] uses force； subdues； oppresses．
P: Pasahati，[pa+sah] to use force，subdue，oppress，overcome M．II，99； Sn．443； Dh．7，128； DhA．III，46； J．IV，126，494； V，27．-- ger．pasayha using force，forcibly，by force D．II，74 （okkassa+）； A．IV，16 （id．）； S．I，143； Sn．72； J．I，143； Pv．II，92； II，910； （read appasayha for suppasayha）； Miln．210 （okassa+； for okkassa?）．Also in cpd．pasayha-kārin using force J．IV，309； V，425．（Page 446）
U: PASAHATI：（pa+sah+a） dùng sức lực，chế ngự，đè nén，ép buộc [aor] pasahi [abs] --hitvā，pasayha

DOP: pasahati pr. 3 sg. [ S. prasahate], overcomes, conquers; is a match for, is able to withstand; Dhp 7 (taṃ ve ~atī Māro vāto rukkhaṃ va dubbalaṃ; Dhp-a I 75, 12 : ~atī ti abhibhavati ajjhottharati); 128 (na vijjati so jagatippadeso yatthaṭṭhitaṃ na ppasahetha maccu, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se nappasaheyya); Sn 443 (yaṃ te taṃ na ppasahati senaṃ loko; Pj II 392, 7 : sahituṃ na sakkoti nābhibhavati vā); Ja IV 126, 22* (pitaraṃ kālakataṃ sutvā na taṃ ~ate dukhaṃ); 135, 31* (amittā na ppasahanti Indaṃ va asurādhipo); VI 14, 10* (nāssa corā ~anti nātimaññeti khattiyo; 14, 28´ : pasayhakāraṃ kātuṃ na sakkoti); — part.pr. ( a ) pasaha(t), mfn. , Th 356 (na ca cittakali punappunaṃ ~aṃ pāparato carissasi, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pasakka; Th-a II 151, 28 : ~an ti sarabhasasaṃghasāhasavasena ~anto, Ce so; Ee sarabhasaṃ sāhasavasena ~anto; Be, Se pasakkā ti saraṇasampassāsavasena); ( b ) pasahanta, mfn. , Th-a II 151, 29 ; — neg. apasahanta, mfn. , Vism 502, 29* (bhaddassāpasahantassa viyogaṃ piyavatthukaṃ) = Paṭis-a 146, 28* ; — absol. ( a ) pasayha ( and pasayhaṃ ?) [ S. prasahya], overcoming; using force, forcibly, by force; Abh 1149 (balakkāre ~a); D II 74, 31 (Vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo tā na okkassa ~a vāsentī ti; Sv 520, 10 : abhibhavitvā ajjhottharitvā); M II 72, 30* (rājā ~a paṭhaviṃ vijitvā, Ce, Se so; Be, Ee ~ā, mc ); 99, 4 (atha ca panāyaṃ samaṇo eko adutiyo ~a maññe āgacchati); S I 143, 30* (gahītanāvaṃ … pamocayitthā balasā ~a) = Ja III 361, 7* (362, 5´ : ~ā ti abhibhavitvā); S III 113, 3 (so ca ārakkhasampanno nāyaṃ sukaro ~a jīvitā voropetuṃ); IV 246, 15 (mātugāmo sāmikaṃ ~a agāraṃ ajjhāvasatī ti); A I 150, 6* (~a Māraṃ abhibhuyya antakaṃ); Sn 72 (sīho yathā … ~a … abhibhuyyacārī; Pj II 127, 18 : ~a abhibhuyyā ti ubhayaṃ cārisaddena saha yojetabbaṃ); Pv 21:2 (imaṃ yakkhaṃ gahetvāna sādhukena ~a vā); Ja IV 347, 11* (eko va seno hanti dije ~a); 494, 8* (senaṃ … pasayha); V 27, 16* (~a khāde; 27, 20´ : balakkārena khādeyyā ti); 121, 4* (api ce labhati mando phītaṃ dharaṇim uttamaṃ akāmassa ~aṃ vā añño taṃ paṭipajjati; 122, 9´ : tassa anicchamānass’ eva pasayhakāraṃ vā pana katvā); Mil 210, 3 (okassa ~a); Mhv 63:16; — ~âvahāra, m. , taking by force, robbery with violence; Vin V 129, 17 ; Sp 375, 28 ; Pj II 183, 5 (~âvahāravasena panthadūsako); — ~-khādaka, mf (-ikā) n. , devouring violently; Ja V 431, 14´ (yathā so kakkhaḷo ~a khādati evaṃ etā pi kakkhaḷā ~-khādikā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~a khādanti); — ~-khādi(n), mfn. , id.; Ja V 425, 9* (sīho … ~-khadī); — ~-pavatta(r), m. , one who speaks (or acts) using force or power; Vin V 184, 14 (~-pavattā hoti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~-vattā; Sp 1372, 22 foll.: anajjhiṭṭho bhāre anāropite kevalaṃ mānaṃ nissāya ajjhottharitvā anadhikāre kathetā hoti); Sadd 845, 30 foll. (~a pavattituṃ sīlaṃ yassa rañño so hoti rājā ~-pavattā, atha vā ~a pavattuṃ kathetuṃ sīlaṃ assā ti ~-pavattā); — absol. ( b ) pasahitvā, Spk II 311, 17 ; Mp II 244, 27 ; — fpp *pasayha 3 , mfn. [ S. prasahya], — neg. appasayha, apasayha, mfn. , not to be overcome; Ap 310, 5 (appasayho sadā homi corapaccatthikehi vā); 319, 1 (kusalo buddhadhamme hi appasayho parehi so, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be apasayho); Spk I 37, 1 (appasayhataṃ āpajjati); — duppasayha, mfn. , hard to overcome; Mil 345, 24 (bhagavato dhammanagaraṃ … evaṃ duppasayhaṃ paccatthikehi paccāmittehi, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se apasayhaṃ); Mhv 58:5; — see also duppasaha; — suppasayha, mfn. , easy to overcome; Pv 21:10 (nāhaṃ devena … suppasayho; Pv-a 117, 21 : na suppasayho ti appadhaṃsiyo).
